title: Japanese-Style Ramen Soup with Fermented Flavor
description: A fusion twist on traditional ramen, blending Japanese flavors with Mexican spices and a dash of fermentation.
instructions: Cook the yellow ramen noodles according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the miso paste over medium heat.
Add the fermented kimchi to the miso paste and stir until combined.
Add the fish sauce, onion, and garlic to the kimchi mixture and stir-fry until the onion is translucent.
Add the soy sauce and chili flakes to the kimchi mixture and stir to combine.
Add the cooked ramen noodles to the kimchi mixture and toss to coat.
Serve the ramen hot, garnished with additional kimchi if desired.
